post.description:
The current Canadian policy rate, the rate in effect on a given date (e.g. at the end of a quarter, for comparison with other central banks), or when and by how much the Bank last moved it.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

date.description: As-of date, YYYY-MM-DD. The rate in effect on it is the latest business-day observation on or before it. Default: the latest published. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

start_date.description: Start of the change history, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: three years before date (or the last three years). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The Bank of Canada policy interest rate (target for the overnight rate, Valet series V39079): the rate in effect today or on any date since 1992, the most recent change and every change in the history window (three years back by default), each with the previous rate and the move in basis points. A decision the series has not yet published (it takes effect the business day after the announcement and reaches the series about a day later) is read from the Bank's press releases and reported as announced_change.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `announced_change` | object | The newest scheduled rate decision from the Bank's press releases when it moves the rate and series V39079 has not yet published its effective date (checked when the wanted date is after the latest observation and within 14 days of today); null otherwise, including once the series has caught up. |
| `as_of` | string |  |
| `attribution` | string | Required attribution under the Bank of Canada terms of use. |
| `changes` | object[] | Rate changes within the history window, newest first, dated the day they took effect (the business day after the announcement); an announced_change in effect is included first. Empty when the rate did not move. |
| `history` | object |  |
| `label` | string |  |
| `last_change` | object | Most recent change within the history window, including an announced_change in effect; null when the rate did not move in it. |
| `note` | string |  |
| `observation_date` | string | Latest business day of series V39079 on or before as_of. When announced_change is in effect, the rate comes from the announcement and this is the last day the series had published. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `rate_percent` | number | Policy rate in percent in effect on as_of: the latest observation on or before it, or the rate set by an announced_change already in effect that the series has not yet published. |
| `series` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string | The Bank of Canada URL that answered (the first page for multi-page scans). |
| `terms_url` | string |  |
| `unit` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.label: Target for the overnight rate (business daily)
value.note: The policy interest rate is the Bank of Canada's target for the overnight rate (Valet series V39079, business daily). The rate in effect on a date is the latest business-day observation on or before it. A rate decision takes effect the business day after its announcement and the series publishes that day about one business day later; until it does, announced_change carries the decision from the Bank's press release and, once in effect, rate_percent and last_change follow it.
